summary: RAG few-shot with semantic NLEmbedding retrieval
hypothesis: Replacing Jaccard word-overlap retrieval with semantic sentence-embedding cosine similarity would better match exemplar task types to novel queries, improving coverage of decision-critical unknowns where Jaccard found near-zero overlap.
technique: A RAG pipeline using on-device NLEmbedding cosine similarity (instead of Jaccard) to retrieve the 2 nearest exemplars by semantic task type, injected as few-shot demonstrations into a single on-device FM call.
label: exp007
